_comment: Dakar Rally. Route outline from ASO's May 2026 announcement (town order only; per-stage distances and bivouacs come with the detailed route, usually late Nov/Dec). 2026 results from the classification. Update `status` and `stages_done` as the rally runs, and fill in `leaders` from the daily standings.

edition.name: Dakar Rally 2027
notes: Longest route in 18 years — only the first South American edition has had more competitive distance since the rally left Africa.
Nine of the thirteen specials exceed 400 km.
Opens 1 January with a 30 km prologue.
Two marathon stages — no team assistance overnight.
Concentrated on Saudi Arabia's western and central regions.

categories.label: Trucks
categories.blurb: T5. Eight-tonne machines with 1,000 horsepower, three crew, and no business being airborne. They are.

categories.label: Bikes
categories.blurb: Solo, no co-driver, roadbook on the handlebars.

last_edition.note: Benavides took the bike title by two seconds after two weeks of racing — the closest finish in the rally's history.

route_outline._note: Announced order of bivouac towns. Lines between them are drawn straight and are only a sketch; the racing lines are never published in advance.
